_doc: Cuss-word regex patterns for sidecaramel.lrc_cusswords. Word-boundary matched, case-insensitive. Multi-word forms first so longer spans consume characters before single-word matchers. Users can override this file via $SIDECARAMEL_CUSSWORDS or by passing custom_patterns= to extract_cuss_windows().
_content_note: This list intentionally includes real slurs and profanity, English and German, because cuss_flip/lrc_cusswords exist to detect and censor exactly this content. Shipping a euphemism list would defeat the tool's purpose. Reviewed and kept deliberately, not an oversight.
_format: List of regex patterns (already-escaped) using Python re syntax.
